map.center: Usamos was / were + -ing para una acción en progreso en un momento del pasado: «estaba haciendo».

good: I was cooking dinner when you called.

explain.es: El past continuous describe una acción que estaba en progreso en un momento del pasado: había empezado antes y todavía no había terminado. En español equivale a «estaba + gerundio» (estaba cocinando) y muchas veces al imperfecto descriptivo (llovía, cocinaba). Es perfecto para describir la escena de fondo de una historia y para acciones interrumpidas por otra.
explain.en: The past continuous describes an action in progress at a moment in the past. We use it for background scenes and interrupted actions.

explain.title: 1 · Afirmativa
explain.es: Se forma con el pasado de to be (was / were) + el verbo con -ing. was con I, he, she, it; were con you, we, they. Ojo: los verbos de estado (know, want, like, need, believe) no suelen ir en continuo: I was knowing → I knew.
explain.en: was (I / he / she / it) or were (you / we / they) + verb-ing. State verbs (know, want, like) don't usually take -ing.

examples.en: I was reading a novel on the train.
examples.es: Estaba leyendo una novela en el tren.
Mis amigos estaban jugando al pádel.
El bebé estuvo llorando toda la noche.

explain.title: 2 · Negativa
explain.es: Añadimos not a was / were: wasn't / weren't + -ing. No usamos didn't: el auxiliar ya es was / were.

examples.en: I wasn't listening, sorry. Can you repeat that?
They weren't working when the boss arrived.
examples.es: No estaban trabajando cuando llegó el jefe.
No estaba lloviendo, así que fuimos andando.

explain.title: 3 · Preguntas y respuestas cortas
explain.es: Was / Were va delante del sujeto. Con palabras interrogativas: What were you doing…? En la respuesta corta usamos solo el auxiliar: Yes, I was. / No, they weren't.
explain.en: Was / Were + subject + -ing? Short answers: Yes, I was. / No, they weren't.

examples.en: Were you sleeping when I called? — Yes, I was.
What were you doing at 10 p.m.? — I was studying.
examples.es: ¿Qué estabas haciendo a las 10 de la noche? — Estaba estudiando.

explain.title: Todo junto
head: Sujeto · Subject
✅ Afirmativa
⛔ Negativa
❓ Pregunta
💬 Respuesta corta
rows: Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.
Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.
Yes, she was. / No, she wasn't.
Yes, we were. / No, we weren't.
Yes, they were. / No, they weren't.
explain.note: you siempre va con were, aunque hables con una sola persona: you was → you were.

explain.title: Ortografía de la -ing
head: Regla · Rule
Ejemplos · Examples
rows: Acaba en -e muda: quita la e
explain.note: No se dobla si la última sílaba no es la fuerte: visit → visiting, listen → listening.
explain.note_en: No doubling if the last syllable isn't stressed: visiting, listening.

explain.title: 4 · En un momento concreto y en historias
explain.title_en: At a specific time and in stories
explain.es: Usamos el past continuous para una acción que estaba en progreso en un momento concreto del pasado: at 8 o'clock, this time yesterday, at midnight. En las historias describe el fondo de la escena (qué estaba pasando), mientras el past simple cuenta los hechos.
explain.en: An action in progress at a specific past time. In stories it describes the background.
formula: At 8 p.m. / This time yesterday + sujeto + *was / were* + verbo-ing

examples.en: At 8 o'clock last night I was studying for my exam.
examples.es: Anoche a las 8 estaba estudiando para el examen.

examples.en: This time yesterday we were flying to Rome.
examples.es: Ayer a esta hora estábamos volando a Roma.

examples.en: It was raining and everyone was running for the bus.
examples.es: Llovía y todo el mundo corría hacia el autobús.

explain.title: 5 · Acción interrumpida: WHEN
explain.es: Una acción larga (past continuous) se ve interrumpida por una acción corta (past simple). La acción corta suele ir con when. Si la frase empieza con When…, pon una coma en medio.
explain.en: A long action (past continuous) is interrupted by a short one (past simple), usually with when.

examples.en: I was having a shower when the doorbell rang.
examples.es: Me estaba duchando cuando sonó el timbre.

examples.en: We were watching the match when the TV broke.
examples.es: Estábamos viendo el partido cuando se rompió la tele.

explain.title: 6 · WHILE (mientras)
explain.es: While («mientras») va con la acción larga, en past continuous. También lo usamos para dos acciones largas que pasaban al mismo tiempo: las dos en past continuous.
explain.en: while + the long action (past continuous). Two long actions at the same time: both continuous.

examples.en: While I was walking to work, I saw an accident.
examples.es: Mientras iba andando al trabajo, vi un accidente.
Me corté el dedo mientras cocinaba.

examples.en: While Dad was cooking, we were setting the table.
examples.es: Mientras papá cocinaba, nosotros poníamos la mesa.

explain.title: PAST SIMPLE o PAST CONTINUOUS
explain.es: El past simple presenta la acción completa (o una detrás de otra); el past continuous, en progreso. ¡Mira cómo cambia el significado!
explain.en: Past simple = complete action or sequence. Past continuous = in progress.

cols.head: ⏹️ Past simple · completa
items: When she arrived, we had dinner. (Llegó y luego cenamos.)

cols.head: 🎞️ Past continuous · en progreso
items: When she arrived, we were having dinner. (Ya estábamos cenando.)

explain.title: WHEN o WHILE
explain.es: when suele introducir la acción corta (past simple). while introduce la acción larga (past continuous). Las dos pueden ir al principio o en medio de la frase.

cols.head: ⚡ when + acción corta
items: I was walking home when I saw him.
When the alarm went off, I was sleeping.

cols.head: ⏳ while + acción larga
items: While I was walking home, I saw him.
I fell asleep while I was watching the film.

items.bad: I was cook dinner when you called.
items.good: I was cooking dinner when you called.
items.why: Después de was / were, el verbo lleva -ing.
you siempre con were, aunque sea una persona.
Verbos de estado (know, want, like) → past simple.

items.bad: While I watched TV, the phone was ringing.
items.good: While I was watching TV, the phone rang.

items.bad: Did you sleeping when I called?
I was travelling to Paris last year. It was great!
items.why: Acción completa y terminada → past simple.

items.bad: She was swiming in the sea.

items.es: Elige el auxiliar: I / he / she / it → was; you / we / they → were.
Añade -ing al verbo (¡ojo con la ortografía!).
¿La interrumpe una acción corta? → esa va en past simple, normalmente con when.
items.en: Short interrupting action → past simple + when.

items.es: ¿Dos acciones largas a la vez? → las dos en continuous, con while.
items.en: Two long actions → both continuous + while.

items.es: ¿Es un verbo de estado (know, want, like)? → past simple.

explain.title: Truco de la película
explain.es: Imagina una película 🎬. El past continuous es la escena de fondo: la cámara ya estaba grabando (llovía, la gente corría). El past simple es la acción que aparece de repente (sonó el teléfono). Ojo: si «-aba / -ía» es un hábito (de pequeño jugaba al fútbol), no uses el continuous.
explain.en: Past continuous = the background scene. Past simple = the sudden action. Habits don't use the past continuous.

items.q: We form the past continuous with was / were + -ing.
«You was working» is correct.
In «I was cooking when the phone rang», the long action is «was cooking».
We usually use «while» with the short action.
«I was knowing the answer» is correct.
items.why: know es de estado: I knew the answer.

items.q: The past continuous is good for describing the background of a story.
«When she arrived, we had dinner» = «When she arrived, we were having dinner».
items.why: had = cenamos después; were having = ya estábamos cenando.

items.q: The -ing form of «run» is «running».

exercises.title: Lee y contesta
exercises.es: Lee la historia de Marcos. Marca T (true) o F (false) y contesta las preguntas.
exercises.en: Read Marcos's story. Tick T or F and answer the questions.
text: It was a dark, windy night in November. I was home alone because my parents were visiting my grandmother. I was lying on the sofa and I was watching a horror film. Outside, the rain was falling heavily and the wind was blowing through the trees.

At about eleven o'clock, while I was making some popcorn, the lights suddenly went out. Then I heard a strange noise at the back door. Someone was trying to open it! My heart was beating very fast. I picked up my phone and called my dad.

While I was talking to him, the door opened… and our dog, Bruno, ran in! He was wet and very happy. My neighbour was standing behind him with a torch. “He was hiding in my garden,” she said. “Sorry if I scared you!”

items.q: Marcos's parents were at home.
It was raining that night.
The lights went out while Marcos was making popcorn.
What was Marcos doing on the sofa?
items.a: He was watching a horror film.

items.q: What was happening at the back door?
items.a: Someone was trying to open it.

items.q: Who was Marcos talking to when the door opened?
items.a: He was talking to his dad.

items.q: Where was Bruno hiding?
items.a: He was hiding in the neighbour's garden.
